text:
Lina (Product): quick q — thinking about an 'SLO tweak' surface in the console where CS can propose temporary threshold adjustments per-tenant without creating new alert rules. want to understand API implications and noise/telemetry impact
Raj (Eng): interesting. so you mean an overlay that sits on top of canonical rule and doesn't duplicate alert objects?
Lina (Product): exactly — overlay + expiration + audit trail. we want it transient (hours->days) and visible in console, but not create a ton of rule churn in the backend
Tomas (Eng-Platform): doable. two approaches: 1) annotation-only — UI stores tenant overrides in a separate overlay collection and notify-service merges on evaluation time; 2) materialize-per-tenant rule for evaluation. first is lighter weight but requires evaluation-time merge logic
Jess (SRE): annotation approach sounds safer for storage, but we need to think telemetry: how will per-tenant toggles show up in alert counts and test harnesses? we can't lose signal for aggregation queries
Raj (Eng): agree. also need to consider fanout cost. if we keep evaluation-time merging we add a small per-eval lookup (cacheable). materializing rules multiplies rule count by tenants -> bad for scale
Tomas (Eng-Platform): sketch of overlay API (very rough):
```json
POST /api/v1/tenants/{tid}/slo-overrides
{
  "overlay_id": "string",
  "base_slo_id": "slo-123",
  "threshold": 0.99,
  "expires_at": 1680000000,
  "priority": "temp-cs",
  "reason": "demo-adjustment",
}
```
Raj (Eng): we should also include `sample_rate` or `telemetry_tag` so we can mark alerts produced under an override for backfill/analysis
Lina (Product): nice, we want audit log + acceptance checkbox in CS UI. also want a 'preview' that shows estimated change in alert volume before applying
Jess (SRE): preview requires simulation run against recent telemetry window — could be expensive. maybe approximate by scoring current eval hits against the prospective threshold and sampling results
Tomas (Eng-Platform): right — we can run a quick heuristic: take last N windows, compute hits if override applied, and return counts + pct change. do sampling to bound cost. label preview results with `approximate:true`
Raj (Eng): another concern: notification routing. If a tenant lowers threshold, routing/quotas may change (more pages). we need a policy: overrides should opt-in to existing escalation matrix or use a 'soft' notify channel (CS only) by default
Lina (Product): proposal: default to 'CS & audit' only, require explicit checkbox to escalate to customer on-call. keeps noise down and prevents breaking customer playbooks
Jess (SRE): +1. also add rate limits on overrides per-tenant (eg max 5 active overlays) and a global backpressure guard so we don't suddenly blow up the notify pipeline
Tomas (Eng-Platform): implementation notes: store overlays in a small k/v service with TTL, integrate with eval path: on rule evaluation, look up tenant overlays (cache per-rule+tenant TTL=60s), merge thresholds, emit a distinct telemetry tag `override_id` on alerts
Raj (Eng): that tag will let us filter/regressions. we should also increment a `override_applied` metric so we can monitor how many alerts are coming from overlays
Lina (Product): rollout plan: feature flag the UI + API, pilot with 3 enterprise tenants, run with preview-only for 2 weeks, then enable apply but keep CS-only notify for first month
Jess (SRE): ops checklist: add alerting for `override_applied` spike, dashboard showing overrides by tenant, and a user-facing audit timeline in console. also require an expiration default (48h) to avoid indefinite tweaks
Tomas (Eng-Platform): will prototype API and cache shim. ping me for contract review. can we get a simple example payload for preview endpoint too?
Lina (Product): I'll mock a preview call for you tonight. thanks all :purple_heart: 
alert-bot: Note: config-deploy job queued for branch `slo-overlay-proto`. watch logs at https://ci.redwood.local/builds/7821 :gear:
Raj (Eng): quick follow-up — we need to confirm how overrides interplay with canary rollouts and canary SLOs. if a canary triggers, do overlays apply to canary tenants? probably no by default
Jess (SRE): default no. canary should be isolated. add `applies_to` field in overlay (tenant|tenant_group|exclude_canary)
Lina (Product): great, let's capture these decisions in the RFC doc and I'll add product acceptance criteria. small next steps: Tomas prototype + Raj metrics hooks + Jess ops runbook
Tomas (Eng-Platform): noted. I'll drop a short PR with proto API and cache plan by EOD tomorrow
Lina (Product): awesome, thanks team!
